launcher-images.name: The Carina Nebula
launcher-images.author: NASA, ESA / STScI (Hubble)
launcher-images.summary: A wide Hubble panorama of the Carina Nebula in bone light.
launcher-images.description: The Hubble Space Telescope's panorama of the Carina Nebula (NGC 3372) - towers and clouds of glowing gas around unstable young stars - dithered so the nebular light reads as Ryoku bone.

launcher-images.name: The Great Wave
launcher-images.author: Katsushika Hokusai (c.1831)
launcher-images.summary: Hokusai's great wave curling over a distant Fuji, in bone.
launcher-images.description: Under the Wave off Kanagawa (The Great Wave) from Hokusai's Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji - the towering breaker and its claw of foam above a small Fuji - reduced to Ryoku's one-bit bone.

launcher-images.name: The Ninth Wave
launcher-images.author: Ivan Aivazovsky (1850)
launcher-images.summary: Aivazovsky's dawn breaking over survivors and a vast swell.
launcher-images.description: The Ninth Wave - Ivan Aivazovsky's shipwreck survivors clinging to a mast as a warm dawn breaks over the towering sea - reduced to Ryoku's one-bit bone.

launcher-images.name: The Sea of Ice
launcher-images.author: Caspar David Friedrich (1823-1824)
launcher-images.summary: Friedrich's shattered polar ice heaved over a lost ship.
launcher-images.description: The Sea of Ice (Das Eismeer) - Caspar David Friedrich's slabs of polar ice piled into a jagged pyramid above a crushed hull - reduced to Ryoku's one-bit bone.

launcher-images.name: Driving Rain at Shono
launcher-images.author: Utagawa Hiroshige (c.1833)
launcher-images.summary: Hiroshige's travellers bent under a grey downpour at Shono.
launcher-images.description: Driving Rain at Shono (Shono hakuu), station 46 of Hiroshige's Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido - porters and a palanquin hurrying through slanting rain - baked to Ryoku's one-bit bone.

launcher-images.name: Wheatfield with Crows
launcher-images.author: Vincent van Gogh (1890)
launcher-images.summary: Van Gogh's crows scattering over a storm-dark wheatfield.
launcher-images.description: Wheatfield with Crows - Van Gogh's turbulent sky, golden wheat, and a flock of black crows over three diverging paths - baked to Ryoku's one-bit bone.
